content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: XQL(AIRS LLM10 Token Usage Rolling Sum Exceeds Per User Budget) OR XQL(AIRS LLM10 P95 Latency On Chat Endpoint Exceeds Threshold Under Load) OR XQL(AIRS LLM10 NGFW Sustained POST Burst Flagged Anomalous App Traffic)
rules.name: AIRS LLM10 Token Budget Breach Plus Latency Anomaly Plus POST Burst
